look.intro: Applies to your account everywhere: desktop, all windows and phone. Every change shows at once.
look.autosave: Changes apply at once and are saved.
look.glassHint: How much windows, menus and bars let through
look.liquidHint: As in iOS: “Clear” lets more of the background through, “Tinted” makes bars, dock, widgets and menus more opaque. Content stays readable.
look.liquidSample: This is how the glass looks
look.cornersHint: Rounding of windows, cards and buttons
look.saturationHint: Saturation of the accent colour and the wallpaper
look.dock.title: Dock
look.dock.link: Show, position, size and kept programs
look.dock.intro: The dock at the edge of the desktop. Every change applies at once.
look.dock.appsHint: Change the order by dragging or with the arrows.
look.dock.rightClickHint: On the desktop too: right-click a free spot of the dock to open “Edit dock”.
look.shineHint: Bright top edge of glass surfaces
look.dimHint: How much the page behind a dialog is darkened
look.languageHint: Language of the interface for this account.
